item.title: Jensen Huang’s fall sparks dismay in Asia over Nvidia ex-CEO’s family man image
item.description: Tech titan Jensen Huang, dressed in his signature leather jacket, has always carried the charisma of a rock star during his public appearances around the world. That allure runs deep in South Korea, where he has had viral dinners at local fried chicken joints as onlookers jostled for a glimpse of the AI chip visionary. item.description: The Hong Kong government is facing mounting pressure to launch a second-tier accountability investigation into department heads over the Queen Mary Hospital lift scandal, but the development minister has said such a probe would be considered only if wider systemic problems emerged. item.title: Destroy raided documents, Dutch court tells Jaguar Land Rover in IP fight with BYD
item.description: A Dutch court has rendered a ruling in favour of BYD in the Chinese electric vehicle (EV) giant’s dispute with Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) over the British luxury carmaker’s intellectual property (IP) claims. JLR was ordered to destroy documents obtained in a raid of BYD’s Netherlands offices, according to a ruling published by the District Court of The Hague on Thursday. Judge HFR van Heemstra said in the ruling that the materials had to be destroyed within 24 hours, with JLR facing a fine of...

item.title: Hong Kong government lowers down payment on subsidised flats for young parents
item.description: Young Hong Kong couples have been given another incentive to have children, with officials lowering the down payment required when buying a subsidised flat. The Housing Authority said on Friday that a committee had approved two enhanced measures for subsidised sale flats.
